title: Verifier acceptance condition
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, and let $st$ be a verifier state. The state is accepting exactly when its designated Boolean flag is true and every Boolean entry of its work-tape flag vector is true.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
